title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds to be Paid as Compensation to the Widows of Certain Deceased Senators
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Funds to be Paid as Compensation to the Widows of Certain Deceased Senators

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2634_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of seventy-two thousand pesos is appropriated to be paid as compensation to the widows of the late Senators Manuel C. Briones, Ruperto K. Kangleon, Emiliano Tirona, Esteban Abada and Jose Ozamiz, at the rate of fourteen thousand four hundred pesos each, which compensation shall not be subject to attachment, levy, execution, or any tax whatsoever.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
